4. **Calculate the required capacity**  

   \[
   \text{Required nodes} = \text{Current nodes} \times (1 + \text{increase fraction})
   \]

   \[
   \text{Required nodes} = 2 \times (1 + 0.40) = 2 \times 1.40 = 2.8
   \]

5. **Round up to whole nodes**

6. **Determine how many additional nodes are needed**  

   \[
   \text{Additional nodes} = \text{Rounded required nodes} - \text{Current nodes}
   \]

   \[
   \text{Additional nodes} = 3 - 2 = 1
   \]

---
